source_refs.note: Sub-heading 'Uses of Computer Network' of 1.1 as printed (PDF 7, printed 2).

blocks.text: Internet browsing is a common example of network use. Mobile phones use networks for calls, messages, and apps. Schools use networks for online classes and learning systems. Banks use networks for online transactions and ATMs. Social media platforms work through computer networks. Smart homes also use networks to control devices.
